full_judgment: 6. It is contended on behalf of the petitioners that the service of the notices under section 5 (Ia) and 5(3) of the Act cannot be presumed under the law particularly when the same is an integral part of the due process before one can be deprived of one's land and that strict compliance thereof is a sine qua non and the burden of such proof cannot be shifted upon the owner denying such receipt.
